title: Weakly Supervised Pixel-Level Annotation with Visual Interpretability
core_idea: Propose an automated explainable annotation system that combines an ensemble of pre-trained deep models (ResNet50, EfficientNet, DenseNet) with XGrad-CAM for visual explanations and Monte Carlo dropout for uncertainty quantification; intersecting saliency maps from models that agree to produce pixel-level annotations from image-level labels and flagging uncertain predictions for human review to mimic radiologist consensus.
tldr: An ensemble-based, explainable weakly supervised method that generates pixel-level annotations from image-level labels using visual explanations and uncertainty estimates, with uncertain cases routed to human review.
